risksAndRequiredValidation: Birth quality improves within the existing range; this is not a guarantee of a chosen real-player template or a claim that every selected player is better for all targets.

The22-point expected starting increase can improve template access, but may increase99-stat saturation and reduce net-growth-based fame at the same finished stats; shadow testing must measure growth waste and fame as well as tiers and time.
Higher starting stats do not alter innate growth bias, height eligibility, template stability rules or experience requirements.
Free repeated screening still exists. The paid option monetizes avoided screening and targeted starting quality; actual willingness to buy has not been measured.
If the earned-template retention rule selects an earlier same-tier player, better stats alone may not unlock the desired missing template; test target-template identities, not only highest tier.
A cost above the current33-credit ceiling prevents direct coupon arbitrage for this paid recruit, but does not prove that aggregate late-game currency stops accumulating.
12.45/18/24/33 are transparent repayment assumptions. Only actual controlled paid-versus-free growth experiments can estimate the selected-recruit return distribution.
36 must be rechecked if future template, training, cooperation or equipment rewards raise the maximum recommendation above33.
